image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a metallic breastplate (cuirass) mounted against a plain, light-colored wall. The armor is silver-toned with a brushed or matte finish rather than a mirror polish, featuring embossed geometric chevron patterns on the lower abdomen section and a central vertical ridge. Rivets are visible along the edges and at the shoulder attachment points.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'shield' or 'suit of armor'.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, scratches, and embossed details for any AI-generation smoothing or texture anomalies.
To verify the 3D curvature of the plate and ensure the embossed patterns have correct depth relative to the base metal.

focus_areas: Metallic reflectivity and specular highlights consistency
Edge sharpness and boundary definition against background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between light and the metal surface. AI images often fail to render complex specular highlights on curved metallic surfaces correctly, resulting in 'muddy' or inconsistent reflections. Verify if the embossed chevrons look physically stamped into the metal or merely painted on.
